articles.title: Countdown underway for critical moon rocket fueling test Monday
articles.summary: The countdown began Saturday evening and will continue through the start of a simulated launch window opening at 9 p.m. EST Monday. The test started two days late because of predicted arctic weather along Florida's Space Coast.
